changelog: IMPORTANT: this version cannot be installed from inside the game with the version you are running. Download it from your Cfx portal, copy it over the old folder (keep your data folder), type refresh, then restart sals_kewlholidays. In-game updates work again from 1.6.1 on.

**No more square glow around each bulb.** Up close, lights on a float or a building showed a hard-edged colored diamond around every bulb, even under the soft glow. When a frame has more bulbs than soft glows to go around, the bulbs without one used to get a big flat stand-in glow, and a flat shape that size reads as a square however faint. Those bulbs now get a small colored body around the bright filament instead, and a bulb with a soft glow gets nothing under it.

**Bulbs are round up close, not diamonds.** Within 10 m, where a bulb is big enough on screen for its shape to show, it is drawn round. Round costs more to draw, so it only uses what the frame has left over after every string has its share: no display drops bulbs for it. A display too big for the leftover keeps its diamond bulbs up close, a whole string at a time (never round for half a string). Farther away a bulb is a few pixels and looks the same either way.
Setting **Round bulbs within (m)** (`Lights.RoundDistance`, default 10) in Settings > Lights. 0 turns round bulbs off.
